none: PAS SUSS-E6BAA8: Roman Coin: Numms of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: West Sussex (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy Roman nummus of the House of Constantine, probably issued by Constantine I, Constantine II or Crispus (Caesar), dating to between AD 321-324 (Reece Period 16). BEATA TRANQVILLITAS or BEAT TRANQVILITAS reverse type depicting a globe on altar inscribed with VOTIS [...]. Mint unknown. Both legends are nearly illegible and as such, a more specific identification is difficult
